about.heading: One Day. One Community. Countless Possibilities.
about.subheading: The Culminating Leadership Project for Student Builders
about.description: AWS Student Community Day (SCD) is a premier one-day, student-led technical conference recognized in the AWS Playbook as the culminating capstone achievement for Student Builder Group Leaders. Bringing together five industry speakers, enterprise cloud & AI leaders, and student developers, SCD delivers real-world cloud exposure, certification pathways, hands-on practice, and builder community culture.

highlights.title: Keynote Sessions: Cloud Careers & Future
highlights.description: Cloud Career Pathways with Amit Kumar (AWS) and Future in Cloud Computing with Dipali Kulshreshta.

highlights.title: Generative AI on AWS: Bedrock & SageMaker
highlights.description: Deep technical walkthrough by Diksha Verma covering Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, and real-world GenAI use cases.

highlights.title: Hands-On Technical Workshop
highlights.description: 60-minute practical, console-based hands-on architecture workshop led by Prabhakar Mishra (Wipro) plus a dedicated workshop quiz.

highlights.title: Panel: Women in Tech and Startups
highlights.description: Led by Namitha Sharma with Amit Kumar, Diksha Verma, Prabhakar Mishra, and Dipali Kulshreshta sharing startup and career journeys.

highlights.title: Builder Passport, Quizzes & Game Zone
highlights.description: GenAI & Workshop Kahoot quizzes, three parallel Game Zone stations (AWS Solitaire Service, AWS Puzzle, AWS Bingo), Rapid Fire, and Guess the Service.

highlights.title: Digital Certificates, Swags & Prizes
highlights.description: Earn verified digital certificates (emailed within 48 hours), exit-desk event swag kits, and Builder Passport grand prizes.

schedule.title: Keynote 1: Cloud Career Pathways

schedule.description: 30-minute keynote talk followed by 10-minute audience Q&A on navigating cloud certifications, technical growth, and AWS career pathways.

schedule.title: Lunch & Parallel Game Zone (3 Games + Ask-the-Expert Tables)

schedule.title: Panel Discussion: Women in Tech and Startups

schedule.description: 35-minute guided discussion with all five speakers on stage exploring women in tech, startup journeys, and cloud careers, plus 10-minute audience Q&A.

schedule.title: Guess the AWS Service Flash Round
schedule.speaker: Host Team
schedule.description: Clue-based lightning AWS service recognition challenge shown on screen with on-the-spot prizes.

schedule.title: Keynote 2: Future in Cloud Computing
schedule.speaker: Dipali Kulshreshta (Enterprise Cloud & AI Transformation Leader)
schedule.description: 30-minute keynote address exploring enterprise cloud transformation, AI acceleration, and future engineering skillsets, followed by 10-minute Q&A.

faqs.question: What is the registration fee for AWS Student Community Day 2026?
faqs.answer: The registration fee is ₹45 per participant. This covers your event entry, Builder Passport, attendee swag kit, session access, and verification credentials.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to attend?
faqs.answer: All college students from any branch or year who are interested in cloud computing, Generative AI, and building technology can attend.

faqs.question: How will I receive my event entry pass?
faqs.answer: After you register at /community-day/register and your payment is confirmed, your digital entry pass with a unique QR code will be generated on 17–18 November and sent to your email address.

faqs.question: Are seats limited?
faqs.answer: Yes. Due to auditorium capacity, registration is strictly limited to 200 attendees on a first-come, first-served basis.

faqs.question: Will participants receive a certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes, verified participants who attend the full-day summit will receive an official digital Certificate of Participation emailed within 48 hours.
